patterns.note: A minimalist, airy layout with generous negative space, presenting each font example as a distinct, full-width section with a large visual and accompanying text.

The site heavily features highly decorative and experimental display typefaces as primary visual elements and section titles, contrasting them with a clean, functional sans-serif for navigation and body text.
A predominantly monochrome palette of black, white, and light grey is used, allowing the intricate and varied typography to serve as the main visual focal point.

The top navigation bar transforms from a transparent, centered text-only layout to a sticky bar with a solid background, left-aligned logo, and right-aligned menu items as the user scrolls down the page.
Each font family is introduced as a dedicated section, starting with its name as a prominent heading, followed by visual examples of its application and character sets.

technique_notes: The header dynamically changes its appearance and position: initially transparent and centered, it transitions to a solid background, shifts its logo and menu alignment, and becomes fixed to the top of the viewport once the user scrolls past the initial hero content.

Content sections are revealed through standard vertical scrolling, with new blocks of information appearing as the user progresses down the page. A 'Back to Top' link becomes visible at a significant scroll depth to aid navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Features oversized, highly decorative display headings for section titles and brand identity, contrasted with a legible, balanced sans-serif for body text and navigation.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with significant negative space around major content blocks and between sections, creating a clean and uncluttered presentation.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its bold and unapologetic use of highly experimental and decorative typography as the primary visual and branding element. Instead of relying on imagery, the site leverages intricate and unique font designs to create a strong aesthetic identity and showcase its product, making the typography itself the hero.
